messages:
anna_docs: quick heads-up 1 PR #6187 is ready for merge into main. It's the on-prem KMS walkthrough with new code examples. preview: https://ci.redwood/p/6187/preview

jenna_legal: Thanks. Spot-checked the snippets and one contains a realistic AWS account id and a vanity host. Please swap to placeholders before we sign off.

anna_docs: Can you point to the exact lines?

jenna_legal: examples/onprem/setup.md around the block starting with ```bash
export KMS_ARN=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:555666777888:key/aa11-bb22
```
Prefer `000000000000` or `{{KMS_KEY_ARN}}` and add a comment like `# example only, do not use`

kevin_security: Also remove the `storage.company-corp.com` host in the sample wiring. Use `storage.example.local`. Do not include any internal domains in public docs. After changes run the docs preview and the static secrets scan.

oscar_engineering: I'll make a quick patch on top of the branch (branch: docs/6187-redact-examples). Will replace account IDs, swap domain, and replace sample base64 with `<REDACTED_SAMPLE_KEY>`.

anna_docs: Great. Please push and link the compare URL here; we'll keep commit history small and squash into the main PR.

oscar_engineering: Pushed: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/compare/6187...docs/6187-redact-examples. Commit msg: "redact KMS/sample host; add example-only comments"

docs-ci-bot: Preview for docs/6187-redact-examples queued: https://ci.redwood/p/6187/preview?run=2

docs-ci-bot: static-scan: clean. link-checker: 1 broken anchor in examples/onprem/faq.md (not related).

jenna_legal: I need the PR description to include: "Legal review: no customer data, placeholders used; reviewed on slack by @jenna_legal" so the audit trail is explicit.

kevin_security: Please add me as an approver on the PR. Security tentative approval after preview green.

maya_pm: FYI product asked for this to ship before the onboarding next Tue. If we hit any blockers > 24h we should publish a temporary draft and notify the customer.

anna_docs: Plan: wait for second preview and approvals, target merge tomorrow 11:30 PT. If anything blocks, we'll do a controlled release.

oscar_engineering: Preview run 2 is green: https://ci.redwood/p/6187/preview?run=2. Updated PR description per legal.

jenna_legal: Reviewed the updated snippets and comments. Legal sign-off: jenna_legal ✅

kevin_security: Security sign-off: kevin_security ✅ (no hostnames, samples redacted, static scan clean)

anna_docs: Merging now in the planned window. I'll add an entry to the docs changelog noting sample redaction and the legal approval link.

oscar_engineering: Merge complete. Site build kicked off: https://ci.redwood/p/6187/status.

docs-ci-bot: Prod deploy scheduled; docs site will publish in ~10-20 minutes.

maya_pm: Thanks all for the quick turnaround. Noted in the onboarding checklist.

anna_docs: Closing thread. If anyone spots issues on the live page, ping me here and I9ll open a hotfix thread.
